svg.title: Offset removal must preserve the desired near-DC observable
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Offset removal must preserve the desired near-DC observable
Supplied first-order AC coupling: corner 100 Hz
Same filter: phase is part of coherent fidelity
A true 10 Hz component loses 20.0432 dB and advances 84.2894°; DC is erased.
A separate valid blank can estimate d; an operational mean cannot distinguish d from desired DC.
Changing impedance / LO leakage between blank and operation invalidates that estimate.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
